prompt: The helicopter came in March. They cut everything. The man from the program gave me a leaflet about growing hearts of palm. Hearts of palm take four years. My children eat now, not in four years. I know what the coca goes to when it leaves here. I am not a fool. But I also know what my children eat and where that came from. What does a person plant when they need to eat before the harvest?
